## What landed

**Conform (CC3 — one story).** `crates/hh-ontology/src/debt.rs`
`impl Default for DebtPolicy`: `min_runway_ms` 30 d → **60 d**,
`warn_within_ms` 14 d → **30 d**; `hypothesized_max_age_ms` 90 d and
`grace_period_ms` 30 d already matched the §5h.6 proposals and stand.
`evidence_max_age_ms` (180 d) untouched — OQ-304's sibling is separately
cell'd. Both doc comments (the struct + the `Default` impl) now record
the ruling dated — the old text claimed fidelity to the ADR-0214
proposals while carrying divergent values (the CF-489 contradiction).

**Caller/test sweep — clean.** Every consumer reads the operative
policy, never the literals: `hh-debt` (`schedule.rs` `InsufficientRunway`
→ `DeferredReason`, `manager.rs` report path), `hh-hir`
(`validate_for_home`/`validate_removal_test` `ctx.policy` runway leg),
`hh-embed` (`policy_of` decode + `evaluate_debt_on_lifecycle` +
`lab.debt.report`), `hh-lab` (`AssumptionDebtHealth.warn_within_ms`,
`evaluate_debt` grace/probation legs), `hh-registry` (conditioned-rule
validation). Tests that exercise the boundaries pin explicit non-default
values — `hh-hir/tests/debt.rs` sets `min_runway_ms = 1_000`,
`hh-lab/tests/retirement.rs` sets `warn_within_ms: 1_000`,
`hh-lab/tests/r2_17.rs` sets `grace_period_ms: 30_000`,
`hh-lab/tests/unit.rs` uses `AssumptionDebtHealth::DEFAULT_WARN_WITHIN_MS`
(7 d — a separate OQ-446/OQ-364 placeholder for the health view, *not*
`DebtPolicy.warn_within`). Fixtures with real expiries sit far outside
both bands (`until − created_at` ≈ 1 ms or ≈ 1157 d; `expiry_at =
now ± 100`). No test asserts the old defaults semantically or
literally — grep for the ms literals (`2592000000`, `1209600000`,
`30 * 24`, `14 * 24`) finds only `debt.rs` itself.

**Registers.** `research/registers/conflicts.md` CF-489 — dated
resolution appended inside the resolution cell; status `open
(2026-10-09)` → `resolved (2026-10-16, R3.9)`; the `[[DEFERRED
ADR-0214: OQ-441]]` markers stand (WS-I6 with WS-C3/WS-I2 owns the
Stage-5 `DebtIndex` re-pin — the conform removes the divergence, it does
not ratify the values). `open-questions.md` OQ-441 — dated note
appended (conform recorded; re-pin stays outstanding). `BACKLOG.csv`
BL-30 + BL-37 `landing` cells — dated `R3.9 (2026-10-16)` progress
notes; both rows stay `open` on their other named-workstream rulings.
No spec-text edit: §5h.6's proposed text already states the values.
